payload.reason: The evidence provides specific prior approaches for style transfer that were tested, including rule-based methods, Multi-Attribute Style Transfer (MAST), and Adversarial Style Transfer (AdvST).

claims.text: The prior approaches tested include a rule-based method, Multi-Attribute Style Transfer (MAST), and Adversarial Style Transfer (AdvST).
The rule-based method achieves good content fidelity but lacks in style preservation compared to MAST and AdvST.
MAST and AdvST are noted for their inability to manipulate content effectively due to different task assumptions.
